title: Nakanai in Papua New Guinea people group profile | Joshua Project
text: Nakanai families organize life around gardens and the sea, growing staples like manioc, sweet potato, breadfruit and tending cash crops such as cacao, oil palm, and copra. Fishing, shellfish gathering, and megapode eggs provide protein, while markets and wage labor supplement income. Kinship networks and clans guide community support, shared feasts, celebrations and responsibilities, with traditional music and dance central to village life.
